info.title: CueMesh cloud v1 — frontend-consumed endpoints
info.description: Derived from docs/cloud-api.md and docs/integration-contract.md at c03029375b14160bd9b39b65cd97e772d7416124. Server owns all accounts. This is the website subset, not a replacement for the authoritative server contract. RunDetail is an internal view model, not a server response. No OAuth, cookie-session, Supabase, or pairing-token endpoints are invented here.

bearerAuth.description: Server-issued CueMesh account token. Never an AI-provider API key.
